According to Figure 2 (left) on page 7, RACE dev accuracy is about **40%** with 0 layers transferred and about **60%** with all 12 layers transferred, a gain of roughly 20 points.

The paper doesn't print these numbers in its text. I read them off the plot (left y-axis, "RACE Dev Accuracy"), so treat them as roughly ±1 point. The solid blue "RACE Dev" line starts near 40 at x=0 and ends near 60 at x=12. It rises fairly steadily as more layers are added.

The text on page 7 only gives a number for MultiNLI: transferring embeddings helps, and each transformer layer adds more, "up to 9% for full transfer on MultiNLI." The authors conclude that "each layer in the pre-trained model contains useful functionality for solving target tasks" (p. 7).
